title: Biceps brachii
summary: A two-headed muscle on the front of the upper arm. It contributes to elbow bending and turning the forearm palm-up.

title: Brachialis
summary: An elbow flexor located across the front of the lower upper arm and elbow. Its distal attachment is on the ulna.

title: Triceps brachii
summary: The three-headed muscle along the back of the upper arm contributes to straightening the elbow.

title: Dumbbell curl
summary: A light-weight elbow-bending exercise. This version follows a gentle public-sector strength routine, with standing or seated execution.

title: Consistency and adherence
summary: ACSM emphasizes regular resistance-training participation for healthy adults, with goals, enjoyment and safety guiding an achievable routine.

title: Muscle hypertrophy
summary: The ACSM summary distinguishes muscle-size goals from strength and power, and describes weekly training volume as a goal-dependent variable.

title: Training to muscular failure
summary: ACSM reports that reaching fatigue or momentary failure did not consistently change outcomes for the average healthy adult in its reviewed evidence.

title: Adult Sleep Duration
summary: The AASM/SRS consensus recommends at least seven hours of sleep regularly for healthy adults. This is a population recommendation, not a personal diagnosis or a maximum.

title: Sleep Timing Regularity
summary: Sleep regularity describes consistency in the timing of falling asleep and waking. The NSF panel concluded that consistent timing matters for health, safety and performance.
